segments.speaker: MAN
segments.en: As I said earlier, there is I think at Rexford an excellent combination of physical and geographical advantages - as well as having a rural setting and still being close to central London, something that will certainly be of interest to you is that Rexford is just 35 minutes from London Airport.

segments.speaker: MAN
segments.en: At Rexford we QJJIQ12 have a strong research capability..We came 7th out of I 0 I universities in last year's research assessment, carried out by a government body and did particularly well in your particular subjects, engineering and science.

segments.speaker: MAN
segments.en: Actually we got a top research grade of five for engineering, geography and computer sciences.

segments.speaker: MAN
segments.en: One further point -and I know from talking to you individually that a number of you may be looking for some experience in industry after the course - is that all our science and engineering research departments have unusually close relationships with industry in the area.

segments.speaker: MAN
segments.en: Anyway that's enough IQ12 sales talk from me ...

segments.speaker: MAN
segments.en: I'll just take a sip of this coffee that's just arrived, thank you, and then I'll say something about what actually happens when you apply.

segments.speaker: MAN
segments.en: Right . ..

segments.speaker: MAN
segments.en: Now if you do decide to make an application, what you do is send it directly to me in my department.

segments.speaker: MAN
segments.en: I will then immediately send confirmation and the application process begins.

segments.speaker: MAN
segments.en: Er . . .

segments.speaker: MAN
segments.en: I'd like to say at this point that you shouldn't worry if this process doesn't work all that quickly - I mean occasionally there are postal problems, but most often the hold-up is caused by references - the people you give as referees, shall we say, take their time to reply.

segments.speaker: MAN
segments.en: Anyway, it's absolutely normal for this process to take three to four months.

segments.speaker: MAN
segments.en: What I do in this period is keep in touch with you and reassure you that things are moving along.

segments.speaker: MAN
segments.en: One of the ways we've devised to help you decide about applying as well as later when you've been accepted . .. hopefully . .. is to put you in contact with, if possible, a student from your own country who is at present studying with us.

segments.speaker: MAN
segments.en: What you can do is phone them up - we will, of course, liaise between you- and discuss your concerns with them.

segments.speaker: MAN
segments.en: That way you can get an objective· opinion of what you can expect if you come to live and study at Rexford - not only the academic atmosphere but important details like what the leisure facilities are like and whether the English weather and food are really as awful as everybody says!

segments.speaker: MAN
segments.en: If you decide you can face it, the contact can also help you just before you leave, with tips on what to pack and that sort of thing.

segments.speaker: MAN
segments.en: At the moment I think we've got two second-year students and one postgraduate from this country. .

segments.speaker: MAN
segments.en: Now to move on to the other concerns you expressed earlier.

segments.speaker: MAN
segments.en: At aUK university- as I'm. sure you know- you will be in an environment where independent learning is the norm, which takes most students a while to adjust to, and at a time when you will be separated from your normal surroundings and, in most cases, your family.

segments.speaker: MAN
segments.en: This can be a difficult time.

segments.speaker: MAN
segments.en: But remember that something like 25% of our student body are international students like yourselves, and that there are several organisations in the university and city whose main purpose is to offer help and ensure that your time with us is enjoyable and useful.

segments.speaker: MAN
segments.en: One or two of you touched on the subject of accommodation earlier.

segments.speaker: MAN
segments.en: So I'll

segments.speaker: JUST ADD A FEW POINTS
segments.en: it is the University's policy to give priority in the allocation of residence places to three categories, and those are: visiting students, exchange students and new postgraquate students.

segments.speaker: JUST ADD A FEW POINTS
segments.en: However, demand exceeds supply, so there is still a need to put your name down early for campus accommodation, particularly if your family is accompanying you.

segments.speaker: JUST ADD A FEW POINTS
segments.en: This means that the earlier you decide whether you want to study with us . .. and so get the procedure moving, the better it will be for everybody.

segments.speaker: JUST ADD A FEW POINTS
segments.en: Yes?

segments.speaker: WOMAN
segments.en: What if you would prefer to live outside the university?

segments.speaker: MAN
segments.en: If you're planning to live off-campus, you've got to sort things out even earlier.

segments.speaker: MAN
segments.en: As with everything in short supply, the good accommodation gets snapped up months before the beginning of term- in other words if you're starting in October you need to be thinking about it in June or at the yer.y latest July.

segments.speaker: MAN
segments.en: So you do need to think very carefully about what you need, how much you can afford to pay, well in advance.

segments.speaker: MAN
segments.en: What you can't do is leave it until a few days before the start of term.

segments.speaker: MAN
segments.en: The agencies in town are pretty good - it's just a matter of contacting them in good time.

segments.speaker: MAN
segments.en: Of course, we have a full-time accommodation officer available to help all students.

segments.speaker: MAN
segments.en: She'll get in touch with you when you're accepted- she's got plenty of contacts in the town and :MU deal with the agencies on your behalf.

segments.speaker: MAN
segments.en: One or two of you asked me earlier about your level of spoken English . .

segments.speaker: MAN
segments.en: Obviously most of you have already achieved a lot- I wish I could speak your language half as well.

segments.speaker: MAN
segments.en: Having said that though, I'm afraid the lecturers will make little or no allowance for the presence of non-native speakers in the audience.

segments.speaker: MAN
segments.en: So anything you can do to improve your spoken English- even beyond the pretty high levels most of you have already reached - will help make your stay with us that bit more fun for you.

segments.speaker: MAN
segments.en: Some extra practice before you arrive is worth more than ... for private lessons afterwards, when you won't really have time.

segments.speaker: MAN
segments.en: Oh .. . and one last thing before I invite further

segments.speaker: QUESTIONS
segments.en: it's very important that you . ..
